business_model.claim: Ryman is a hotel REIT that sells lodging, meeting space, and food and beverage at large group-oriented resorts. Marriott manages the resorts. The network totals 13,461 rooms under the Gaylord Hotels, JW Marriott and Ritz-Carlton brands.
quotes: We specialize in group-oriented, destination hotel assets in urban and resort markets.
Our core holdings include a network of meetings-focused resorts totaling 13,461 rooms that are managed by Marriott under the Gaylord Hotels, JW Marriott, and Ritz-Carlton brands.

business_model.claim: There are three reporting segments: Hospitality, Entertainment, and Corporate and Other. In the last fiscal year reported in the 10-K they made up about 83%, 17% and 0% of total revenues.
quotes: Our operations are organized into three principal business segments

business_model.claim: Hospitality revenue comes from three lines: rooms, food and beverage, and other hotel revenue. In the nine months of the latest 10-Q, food and beverage was the largest line at 856,062, ahead of rooms at 675,533 and other hotel revenue at 221,570 (table in thousands). Total revenues for the period were 2,069,351 (table in thousands).

Hospitality revenue depends on group meetings and conventions, which are booked years ahead, and on occupancy and rate. Group business was about 73% of rooms sold in the last fiscal year reported in the 10-K. Attrition and cancellation fee collections added $44.9 million to hotel revenue that year.
quotes: The results of operations of our Hospitality segment are affected by the number and type of group meetings and conventions scheduled to attend our hotels in a given period.
$44.9 million in attrition and cancellation fee collections

business_model.basis: stated in the cited items; the decline is read directly from the income statement
business_model.claim: The Entertainment segment is the Opry Entertainment Group (OEG), in which Ryman holds an approximate 70% controlling interest. It includes the Grand Ole Opry, Ryman Auditorium, WSM-AM, Ole Red, Category 10, Block 21 and Southern Entertainment. Its revenue for the nine months of the latest 10-Q was 316,186 against 324,443 a year earlier (table in thousands), so it fell slightly.
quotes: which we report as our Entertainment segment

business_model.claim: Ryman does not run its hotels day to day. Its TRS lessees lease the hotels and hire Marriott as manager. Marriott is paid a base fee on gross revenues, about 2% for most Gaylord Hotels, 3% for Gaylord Rockies and JW Marriott Desert Ridge, and 3.5% for JW Marriott Hill Country, plus an incentive fee tied to hotel profitability. Operations are concentrated in one manager.
quotes: We lease or sublease our hotel properties to our TRS lessees, and such TRS lessees have engaged Marriott as a third-party hotel manager pursuant to hotel management agreements.
Additionally, we pay Marriott an incentive management fee based on the profitability of our hotels.
